x: A "B" team, consisting of Boddington, Clark, Cornish, Martin, Snell, Reeve and Sutton also started. From the start our walkers were prominent, together with those of Surrey W.C. and Leicester W.C.—the three teams securing the placings in last year's race.
Reeve, a Club-champion at shorter distances some years back.

Also the field was a really “hot” one, the Achilles team being Ward, McIntyre and Ellis, while the Poly. had Reeve, Furze and Stockwell, and there were, of course, the Birchfield boys to be considered.

Reeve, of Poly, was the actual winner, but was running as an individual. SENIOR MATCH EVENTS.—100 Yards.—(1) Jover (H); (2) Bowers (B); (3) Read (B); (4) Matthews (P). 10.5. 220 Yards.—(1) Jover (H); (2) Cremer (P); (3) Read (B); (4) Peck (P). 23.5. 880 Yards.—(1) Mead (H); (2) Jarlett (B); (3) Morr…

By the time the roundabout at the beginning of Purley Way had been reached he was joined by Reeve of Poly who was also running a blinder. These two fought neck and neck up the aerodrome straight and Pat eventually had to give away a few yards.
